header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Ibn Abbas (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “For a person to walk for the need of his brother (to help him) is better than staying in the masjid (in I'tikaf) for ten years. If a person sits in I'tikaf for one day for the pleasure of Allah Ta'ala, Allah Ta'ala places three trenches as a barrier between him and Jahannam. Each trench is wider than the distance between the heavens and the earth.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ وَاَبِيْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ سَهْلِ نِ اْلاَنْصَارِيِّ ﵃ يَقُوْلَانِ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَا مِنِ امْرِيءٍ يَخْذُلُ اِمْرَءًا مُسْلِمًا فِيْ مَوْضِعٍ يُنْتَهَكُ فِيْهِ حُرْمَتُهِ وَيُنْتَقَصُ فِيْهِ مِنْ عِرْضِهِ اِلَّا خَذَلَهُ اللهُ فِيْ مَوْطِنٍ يُحِبُّ فِيْهِ نُصْرَتَهُ، ومَا مِنِ امْرِيءٍ يَنْصُرُ مُسْلِمًا فِيْ مَوْضِعٍ يُنْتَقَصُ فِيْهِ مِنْ عِرْضِهِ وَيُنْتَهَكُ فِيْهِ مِنْ حُرْمَتِهِ اِلَّا نَصَرَهُ اللهُ فِيْ مَوْطِنٍ يُحِبُّ نُصْرَتَهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب الرجل يذب عن عرض اخيه رقم:٤٨٨٤
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Jabir ibn Abdullah and Hazrat Abu Talhah ibn Sahl Ansari (RA) both narrate that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “Whoever does not help a Muslim when his honour is being taken away and when his dignity is being harmed, Allah Ta'ala will withhold His help from him when he is in need of Allah Ta'ala's help. And whoever helps a Muslim when his honour is being taken away and when his dignity is being harmed, Allah Ta'ala will help him when he is in need of Allah Ta'ala's help.”
